safetyRules: Never run git reset --hard unless explicitly requested.
Do not commit ignored artifacts such as node_modules, dist, .env files, or logs.
If the working tree is dirty when syncing remote changes, stop and ask whether to upload, stash, or cancel.
If build fails during upload, do not commit until the failure is fixed or the user explicitly decides otherwise.
notes: If a pull request from frontend to main already exists, pushing to frontend updates it automatically.
GitHub CLI may not be installed on this machine, so PR creation can be done manually from the compare URL.
